description: ODC: the search attributes of a Semantic Search node through the verbs. ISemanticSearchNode.SearchAttributes is read-only; the Model API edits it through AddSearchableAttributes/RemoveSearchableAttributes. The `set` of such a list takes an array of references and leaves the list EXACTLY equal (removes what is left over, adds what is missing): first Title and Summary, then only Summary. Without this the node stayed with the error SemanticSearch_RequiredSearchAttributes (the phase 1 refusal). The attributes must be IsSearchable beforehand.

expectedMessages.why: ODC: an app (CrossDevice) does not expose a public server action (the live Studio gives an error); the action stays private and without a consumer in this proof job
